name: 2027 New Year AI Trend: You Climb the Giant 2027 Letters
blurb: The 2027 New Year AI trend, also posted as Welcome 2027 and Hello 2027, is a one-photo AI video: you climb giant white marble "2027" letters on a mountain top at sunset, stand on top with open arms, and the camera pulls back to show the whole year.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded photo of the person. A photorealistic vertical photo at golden-hour sunset on a rocky mountain summit high above a range of jagged snow-capped peaks and misty valleys. Giant white marble digits that read 2027 stand in a row along the summit ridge: solid carved stone with soft grey veins and clean rounded edges, each digit about three times as tall as a person, reading 2, 0, 2, 7 from left to right. The camera is close, at a three-quarter angle: the first digit 2 is big in the foreground and the 0, the 2 and the 7 recede behind it along the ridge, every digit sharp and readable. The person from the photo hangs on the side of the front 2, both hands gripping its flat top edge, one boot pressed against the stone, pulling themself up. Head and shoulders turn toward the camera, the face fully visible and lit by the warm low sun, with a happy, determined smile. They wear a light outdoor jacket over the clothes from the photo, trousers and hiking boots. Warm orange and pink sky, long soft shadows, natural skin, real camera detail. Vertical 9:16. Exactly four digits, 2 0 2 7, and one person. No other numbers, no letters, no text, no logos, no watermark.
